Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, reporting strong financial and operational growth including a 144.7% increase in revenue from operations to ₹716.4 Cr and a 46.9% increase in PAT to ₹50.5 Cr compared to Q1 FY26. The company highlighted the commissioning of its new Marol facility in June 2026 adding ~4,000 kg per annum capacity, alongside an upcoming Jaipur facility under construction. Management detailed its ongoing business drivers, product range including new Turkish collections and machine-made plain gold jewellery, and robust quality control frameworks. Shanti Gold International Limited held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 22, 2026, discussing its operational and financial performance, capacity expansion plans, and strategic initiatives. Management highlighted strong revenue and profit growth for the quarter and full year, driven by robust customer traction, increased outsourcing preference among organized retailers, and elevated gold prices.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management stated that the core business PAT margin is expected to be around 4% plus.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing middle-class disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote: Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that despite elevated gold prices, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy transactions particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted an increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers and retailers.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 gross margin stood at 10.9%, EBITDA margin at 10.0%, and PAT margin at 7.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 10.0% PAT Margin: 7.1%

margins_costs.claim: FY26 gross margin was 10.9%, EBITDA margin was 9.9%, and PAT margin was 6.9%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin: 10.9% EBITDA Margin: 9.9% PAT Margin: 6.9%

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 7.88% against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for the quarter stood at 7.88% as against 3.09% in Q4 FY25.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity is approximately 6,700 kg pa in Andheri and Marol post commissioning.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Total capacity on completion including the Jaipur facility is 7,900 kg pa.
The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's present capacity utilization is around 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength while continuing to invest in future growth opportunities.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geopolitical tensions caused the incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary to be extended.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the Marol factory to start within a month or so and the Jaipur factory to start around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory, and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
